manualAndroidEvidence: The screen opened in round mode rather than the full map.
The full map occupied a dedicated route; horizontal panning moved the bracket without moving the page header.
Current, overview and cup controls restored readable focus for a 32-team bracket.
Selecting a tie highlighted its road to the cup and opened a compact details sheet before navigation.
TalkBack was enabled temporarily and caused the full tree to switch visibly to the round-first linear list; the package, notification permission and accessibility settings were restored afterward.

openGate.reason: The visible TalkBack fallback and widget semantics order are proven, but spoken traversal order was not independently verified because UIAutomator returned stale map semantics while TalkBack was bound.
openGate.requiredEvidence: A human TalkBack pass that hears round, teams, score and status in order through the cup.

outOfScope: No iOS build, test or file change.
No Firebase deployment or Remote Config publication.
